svg.title: FIG-08 Predicate wait and external shutdown a notification is a hint, not hardware progress
svg.desc: nx_wait_until: task, one waiter; ready(context): authoritative predicate; port.arm(): capture notification sequence; ready(context): recheck after arm; port.wait(sequence, absolute deadline) backend checks sequence / absolute deadline; final ready check after error / TIMEOUT; predicate true -> SUCCESS; predicate false -> actual port error; true; false; armed; true; false; SUCCESS hint: repeat predicate check; error / TIMEOUT; concurrent completion visible; completion not observed; One executor: service / drain IRQ: latched facts + wake hint; wake(sequence): hint; release publication → acquire observation; application-owned shutdown, not implicit wait; 1 Close producer admission Owner stop requests cancellation of accepted operations; 2 keep owner / IRQ service and drain progressing producer / observer only acquire-observe SETTLED; 3 join producer after its borrow drains related observers must finish their final access; 4 prove owner idle including publication exit request executor to finish, then join; 5 prove hardware RX / IRQ publishers quiescent detach wake, then join other publishers; 6 finally destroy notification / queue / guard retain platform clock / Tick for a running kernel; failed drain / join / quiesce retains storage external escalation, no forced reclaim; no new producer work; Actual SETTLED and observer exit; producer final access ended; owner executor has exited; all publishers have exited; not drained; not joined; publisher remains active; keep executing
